news.title: Bo Horvat scores twice as Islanders beat Blackhawks 4-1
news.ruTitle: Бо Хорват забивает дважды, когда «Айлендерс» обыграли «Блэкхокс» со счетом 4–1
news.description: — Bo Horvat scored twice and the New York Islanders beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-1 on Thursday night.

news.title: Ryan O'Reilly scores go-ahead goal as Predators rally for 5-2 win over Canadiens
news.ruTitle: Райан О'Рейли забивает гол, когда «Хищники» сплотились и одержали победу над «Канадиенс» со счетом 5:2
news.description: — Ryan O’Reilly scored the go-ahead goal with 3:16 remaining, and the Nashville Predators rallied from a 2-0 deficit to beat the Montreal Canadiens 5-2 on Thursday night.

news.title: Yakemchuk breaks late tie in the Senators' 2-1 victory over the Flyers
news.ruTitle: Якемчук разрывает позднюю ничью в победе «Сенаторс» над «Флайерз» со счетом 2:1.
news.description: — Carter Yakemchuk broke a tie on a power play with 6:59 left and the Ottawa Senators held on to beat the winless Philadelphia Flyers 2-1 on Thursday night.

news.title: Pastrnak scores 2 goals, adds 2 assists in the Bruins' 6-1 rout of the Mammoth
news.ruTitle: Пастрняк забил 2 гола и сделал 2 результативные передачи в разгроме "Брюинз" над "Мамонтом" со счетом 6:1.
news.description: — David Pastrnak scored his first two goals of the season and added two assists as the Boston Bruins routed the Utah Mammoth 6-1 in Thursday night.

news.title: Carlson scores twice to help the Lightning beat the Wild 3-2
news.ruTitle: Карлсон забивает дважды и помогает «Лайтнинг» обыграть «Уайлд» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Defenseman John Carlson scored twice for his 11th career multi-goal game, Nikita Kucherov had two assists and Dennis Hildeby made 34 saves in the Tampa Bay Lightning's 3-2 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Thursday night.

news.title: Logan Stankoven's first career hat trick helps Hurricanes beat Canucks 7-2
news.ruTitle: Первый в карьере хет-трик Логана Станковена помог "Харрикейнз" обыграть "Кэнакс" со счетом 7-2.
news.description: — Logan Stankoven had a natural hat trick for his first career three-goal game, and the Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes won at home in their third try this season, 7-2 over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.

news.title: Jake Oettinger has second straight shutout in the Stars' 4-0 victory over the Sabres
news.ruTitle: Джейк Эттингер одержал второй гол подряд в победе «Старз» над «Сэйбрз» со счетом 4:0.
news.description: — Jake Oettinger made 26 saves for his second straight shutout, Mikko Rantanen had a goal and three assists and the Dallas Stars beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-0 on Thursday night.

news.title: Report: Panthers' Marchand out 'a few weeks' with leg injury
news.ruTitle: Отчет: Маршан из "Пантеры" выбыл на "несколько недель" из-за травмы ноги
news.description: Panthers forward Brad Marchand, who injured his left leg in Tuesday's win over the Kings, will miss only "a few weeks," The Associated Press reported.

news.title: Hurricanes' Seth Jarvis sheds no-contact jersey amid shoulder rehab
news.ruTitle: Сет Джарвис из «Харрикейнз» сбросил бесконтактную майку во время реабилитации плеча
news.description: Carolina Hurricanes winger Seth Jarvis has shed his no-contact jersey as he continues his recovery from offseason shoulder surgery.

news.ruTitle: Ажиотаж вокруг фэнтези-хоккеистов: травмы, за которыми нужно следить, и игроки, которых нужно добавить на этой неделе
news.description: Fantasy hockey guide to the headlines around the NHL, including injuries to monitor and players to add.

news.description: The first three days of the earliest leaguewide start in NHL history delivered scores straight out of the 1980s.
